repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是开源的 CapCut 替代品，提供 Web、桌面和移动端视频编辑。基于 Next.js 和 React 构建，采用 Zustand 状态管理与 TypeScript 类型安全。支持时间线多轨道编辑和实时预览，核心优势是隐私优先（视频本地处理）、无订阅费用和水印，为商业闭源编辑器提供强大替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut that provides comprehensive video editing capabilities for web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Built on Next.js and React with Zustand state management, it delivers timeline-based multi-track editing with real-time preview. The project emphasizes privacy by processing videos entirely on-device, eliminating subscriptions and watermarks. Leveraging TypeScript, Bun, and Docker, OpenCut offers a streamlined development experience and a robust, privacy-first substitute for commercial video editing solutions.

repos.description: real time face swap and one-click video deepfake with only a single image
repos.summary_zh: Deep-Live-Cam 是一款实时换脸与深度伪造工具，仅需单张源图像即可实现一键视频换脸。核心技术包括实时面部捕捉、嘴部动作保留与多人脸映射，支持 Windows/Mac 平台。适用于内容创作、直播表演、影视娱乐及视频聊天等场景，内置内容审核机制确保合规使用，强调负责任的 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: Deep-Live-Cam is a real-time face swap and deepfake tool that enables one-click video face replacement with just a single source image. Key technical features include real-time facial capture, mouth mask for natural lip movement preservation, and multi-face mapping for simultaneous subject processing. It supports Windows/Mac platforms and serves content creation, live streaming, film entertainment, and video chat applications. The software incorporates built-in content moderation to prevent misuse and promotes responsible AI usage through ethical guidelines and consent requirements.

repos.description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
repos.summary_zh: Supervision 是 Roboflow 的开源 Python 计算机视觉库，专注提供可复用 CV 工具。它通过 Detections 对象实现多模型输出统一处理，支持标注可视化、跟踪计数、数据集管理和基准测试。模型无关设计集成主流框架，亮点在于高度可定制工具与高效数据流程，适用于实时视频分析与应用开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source Python library for computer vision, providing reusable tools for building CV applications. It features a unified Detections object for integrating outputs from models like Ultralytics and Transformers, along with customizable annotators, object tracking, zone counting, dataset conversion between YOLO/COCO/Pascal VOC, and performance benchmarking. Model-agnostic by design, it emphasizes efficient post-processing and cross-framework compatibility, enabling developers to focus on real-time video analysis and application development.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

repos.description: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

repos.description: Edit videos with coding agents
repos.summary_zh: video-use 是开源视频编辑技能，让编码智能体（Claude Code等）通过自然语言完成剪辑。用户投放原始素材后对话即可输出final.mp4，自动去除语气词与静音、色彩分级、字幕烧录、动画叠加与自我评估。核心以ElevenLabs词级转录+按需视觉合成驱动LLM精准决策，结合ffmpeg渲染，支持会话记忆，无需传统时间线工具。
repos.summary_en: video-use is an open-source skill that lets coding agents (Claude Code etc.) edit videos via natural language. Drop raw footage, chat, and get final.mp4: auto-cuts fillers/dead space, color grades, burns subtitles, generates overlays, and self-evaluates. LLM reasons from ElevenLabs word-level transcripts plus on-demand visual composites, rendered via ffmpeg, with session memory—no timelines or menus needed.

repos.description: 🚀 AI 全自动短视频引擎 | AI Fully Automated Short Video Engine
repos.summary_zh: Pixelle-Video是一款AI全自动短视频引擎。输入主题后自动完成文案撰写、AI配图视频生成、语音合成与视频合成。支持多种AI模型及ComfyUI集成，提供数字人口播和动作迁移功能。零门槛模块化设计，适用于内容创作和营销场景。
repos.summary_en: Pixelle-Video is an AI fully automated short video engine. Simply input a theme, and it auto-generates scripts, AI visuals, voice narration, BGM, and the complete video. It integrates LLMs, TTS, image/video gen models via direct APIs or ComfyUI/RunningHub, with modules for digital humans, image-to-video, and action transfer. Modular design offers zero-threshold creation, perfect for content marketing and social media videos without any editing expertise. The web interface provides easy template and model selection for customized outputs.

repos.description: AI video skill for Claude Code & Codex — cinematic, editable product promos with Remotion: 124 shot recipe cards, 150 motion previews, beat sync, sound design, Motion Workbench & JianYing (CapCut CN) export.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Translate the video from one language to another and embed dubbing & subtitles.
repos.summary_zh: pyVideoTrans 是一款开源视频翻译工具，提供从语音识别、字幕翻译、AI配音到音视频合成的完整自动化流程。支持本地与云端多种 ASR、LLM 和 TTS 模型，集成 F5-TTS 等语音克隆技术，可区分多角色配音。具备交互式编辑、命令行操作及跨平台部署能力，适用于内容创作者与开发者实现高效视频本地化。
repos.summary_en: pyVideoTrans is a powerful open-source video translation toolkit that automates the entire pipeline from speech recognition to AI dubbing and subtitle embedding. It integrates local and cloud APIs for ASR, LLM translation, and TTS, featuring voice cloning (F5-TTS, CosyVoice), multi-role speaker diarization, and interactive proofreading. Supports both GUI and CLI operation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, enabling efficient batch processing and video localization for content creators and developers.

repos.description: 简简单单的看直播
repos.summary_zh: Simple Live 是基于 Flutter 3.38 和 Dart 开发的跨平台直播聚合应用，支持虎牙、斗鱼、B站、抖音四大平台。项目采用 core+app+tv 模块化架构，覆盖 Android/iOS/Windows/macOS/Linux/TV 全终端，集成弹幕系统。作为开源学习项目，展示直播协议解析与 Flutter 全平台开发实践。
repos.summary_en: Simple Live is a cross-platform live streaming aggregation application developed with Flutter 3.38 and Dart language. It integrates mainstream platforms including Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, and TikTok, providing a unified viewing experience. The project adopts a modular architecture with separate core library, console, mobile app, and TV client, supporting Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android TV. Key features include real-time danmaku display and multi-platform synchronization. As an educational open-source project, it showcases practical implementations of live streaming protocol parsing and Flutter's full-platform development capabilities.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo是首家工业级全流程AI影视生产平台，通过AI Agent实现小说到视频的全自动改编。支持剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜制作、AI配音等好莱坞标准工作流，基于Next.js全栈框架与Docker容器化部署，为短剧和漫画视频创作提供可控、高效的生产解决方案。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is the industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film and video production. It automates the entire workflow from novel text to finished videos, featuring AI script analysis, character/scene generation, storyboard production, and multi-voice synthesis following Hollywood-standard pipelines. Built on Next.js 15 full-stack framework with Docker containerization, MySQL database, and Redis queue system, it delivers an industrial-grade solution for short drama and manga video creation, enabling scalable, efficient, and consistent content generation for professional creators.

repos.description: AI that sees your screen, listens to your conversations and tells you what to do
repos.summary_zh: Omi是开源的AI第二大脑，实时捕捉屏幕与对话内容，自动生成转录、摘要及行动项。跨平台支持macOS、iOS、Android及可穿戴设备，采用Swift/Rust/Flutter技术栈，集成Deepgram语音识别与LLM大模型，构建具备长期记忆的智能助手，已获30万+专业人士信赖。
repos.summary_en: Omi is an open-source AI second brain that captures screen content and conversations in real-time, automatically generating transcripts, summaries, and action items. Built with Swift/Rust/Flutter for cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and wearables, it integrates Deepgram speech recognition and LLMs to create a memory-capable AI assistant. The system processes audio via GPU-accelerated VAD and diarization, storing data in Firestore with Redis caching. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals, it offers a chat interface that remembers all user interactions.

repos.description: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.
repos.summary_zh: OpenMotion 是首个全栈智能体视频生成器，支持上传参考视频或粘贴链接，通过 HTML 编码视频，用自有品牌素材重新创作。内置 Motion.md 格式描述镜头顺序与转场，支持 BYOA/BYOK，集成图像、视频、音乐和语音生成。
repos.summary_en: OpenMotion is the first full-stack agentic video generator. Upload a reference video or paste a social link to recreate it with your own brand kit. Code video with HTML, edit timing in Studio, and render MP4. Features Motion.md format for shot order, timing, and transitions. Supports BYOA/BYOK with 22 local agents and built-in models for images, video, music, and voice.

repos.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
repos.summary_zh: Voice-Pro是集YouTube视频下载、人声分离、语音识别、多语言翻译与TTS于一体的AI音频创作平台。基于Gradio构建，集成Whisper、F5-TTS、CosyVoice等前沿模型，支持零样本语音克隆与高质量配音，为创作者提供一站式多语言内容本地化解决方案，显著提升跨语言内容生产效率。
repos.summary_en: Voice-Pro is an all-in-one AI audio creation platform that seamlessly integrates YouTube video downloading, vocal isolation, speech recognition, multilingual translation and text-to-speech capabilities. Built on Gradio with cutting-edge models including Whisper, F5-TTS, E2-TTS and CosyVoice, it enables zero-shot voice cloning and professional-grade dubbing. The platform provides creators and developers with a comprehensive solution for multilingual content localization, significantly enhancing cross-lingual content production efficiency.

repos.description: The open source AI video agent: turns any coding agent into a video agent, with editors to change anything it makes.
repos.summary_zh: OpenFilm是开源AI视频智能体，可将任意编码智能体转化为视频制作工具。它以单个HTML文件为核心，通过frame(t)函数驱动浏览器渲染每一帧，配合Studio编辑器支持手动或对话式修改视频元素，实现从生成到精剪的完整视频创作流程。
repos.summary_en: OpenFilm is an open-source AI video agent that turns any coding agent into a video maker. Using a single HTML file with a frame(t) function, it renders each frame in the browser via WebGL, canvas, SVG, or CSS. The Studio editor lets you manually or conversationally refine every element, trim clips on the timeline, and render MP4s—enabling end-to-end video creation without frameworks like Remotion. It works with Codex, Claude Code, and other agents.

repos.description: 3FUI 是 ffmpeg 在 Windows 上的轻度专业交互外壳，收录大量参数，界面美观，交互友好。此项目面向国内使用环境，让普通人也能够轻松压制视频和转换格式。
repos.summary_zh: 3FUI是Windows平台FFmpeg的专业交互外壳，基于.NET 10与WinForm框架开发。集成40+视频编码器（含硬件加速）、20+音频及10+图片编码器，支持深度自定义参数与无限制批量任务。面向追求参数透明与压制质量的专业用户，提供简洁高效的暗黑风格界面，无广告完全免费，需自备FFmpeg二进制以获得最新性能。
repos.summary_en: 3FUI is a professional interactive shell for FFmpeg on Windows, developed with .NET 10 and WinForm. It integrates 40+ video encoders (including hardware acceleration), 20+ audio and 10+ image encoders, supporting deep custom parameters and unlimited batch processing. Designed for professionals seeking transparent control and high-quality output, it features a clean dark-mode interface, is ad-free and completely free. Users must provide their own FFmpeg binary for optimal performance.

repos.description: Ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources
repos.summary_zh: Xget 是面向开发者的超高性能、安全的一体化加速引擎，专为加速模型、数据集与软件包等资源获取而设计，支持多浏览器扩展与边缘平台部署，并可将资源直接转化为口播视频，无需时间线编辑，显著提升开发与内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Xget is an ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources. It accelerates the retrieval of models, datasets, and packages, supports browser extensions and edge platform deployment, and can turn resources into talking-head videos without timeline editing, boosting development and content creation efficiency.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
repos.summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源的 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持 B 站、YouTube、抖音等多平台视频。通过 Fast-Whisper 实现本地音频转写，结合 GPT 大模型（OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen）自动生成结构化 Markdown 笔记。支持自动截图、视频跳转、多风格摘要，可本地部署保障隐私，适合学习、知识管理与内容创作场景。
repos.summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI-powered video note-taking tool supporting Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin and more. It leverages Fast-Whisper for local audio transcription and GPT models (OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen) to automatically generate structured Markdown notes. Features include auto-screenshots, video timestamp links, customizable summary styles, and local deployment for privacy protection. Ideal for learning, knowledge management, and content creation workflows with GPU acceleration support.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill (Claude Code, Codex & more): Turn any script into animated stickman videos for faceless YouTube, Shorts & TikTok. 14+ styles with voiceover, captions & SFX. Free & open-source (MIT).
repos.summary_zh: Stickman Video Director是一款Codex Skill工具，利用Gemini Omni Flash将任意文案或创意转化为一分钟火柴人视频完整提示包。包含英文配音脚本、六场景导演计划及6个独立生产提示，支持9:16/16:9/1:1格式与明暗主题。核心亮点为故事架构优化、密集视觉隐喻与镜头运动规划、生产一致性锁定及源素材忠实性。适用于YouTube Shorts、TikTok、Instagram Reels等平台的教育短片、励志故事和视觉解说，通过对话式迭代审批提升短视频创作效率与连贯性。
repos.summary_en: Stickman Video Director is a Codex Skill that transforms any copy or idea into a complete one-minute stickman video prompt package using Gemini Omni Flash. It produces a confirmed English voiceover, a detailed six-scene director's proposal, and six standalone production-ready prompts. Supports 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 formats with light/dark themes. Key highlights include stronger story architecture, dense motion planning with metaphors and camera moves, production consistency locks across prompts, format-aware direction, and source fidelity. Ideal for educational shorts, motivational stories, and visual explainers on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube via conversational iterative approval.

repos.description: 一款专注于 AI 多模态翻译的工具，一键自动翻译 RPG/SLG 游戏、Epub/TXT 小说、PDF/Word/MD 文档、Srt/Ass/Vtt 字幕，以及漫画图片、音频与视频等内容。
repos.summary_zh: AiNiee 是一款专注于复杂长文本 AI 翻译的工具，支持游戏、电子书、文档、字幕等全格式一键翻译。采用思维链翻译、上下文关联和 AI 术语表技术突破长文本翻译局限，深度适配 Mtool、Renpy 等游戏提取工具，提供术语提取、AI 润色等质量控制功能，实现高效高质量的多领域翻译。
repos.summary_en: AiNiee is an AI-powered translation tool specialized in complex long-text translation across games, ebooks, documents, and subtitles. It employs chain-of-thought translation, contextual association, and AI glossary to overcome long-text limitations. With deep integration of game extraction tools like Mtool and Renpy, it offers terminology extraction and AI polishing features for efficient, high-quality multilingual translation.

repos.description: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks. By Victor Kuznetsov.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

repos.description: 高颜值第三方 B 站 React Native 客户端
repos.summary_zh: JKVideo 是一款基于 React Native 和 Expo 构建的高颜值第三方 B 站客户端，支持 Android、iOS 和 Web 三端。核心亮点包括完整的 DASH 视频播放系统（4K HDR）、实时弹幕同步、纯 TypeScript 实现的 WBI 签名算法，以及 Zustand 状态管理。提供扫码登录、下载管理和局域网分享功能，是跨平台视频应用开发的优秀实践。
repos.summary_en: JKVideo is a high-quality third-party Bilibili client built with React Native and Expo, supporting Android, iOS, and Web platforms. Key features include complete DASH video playback (4K HDR), real-time danmaku synchronization, pure TypeScript WBI signing algorithm, and Zustand state management. It offers QR code login, download management, and LAN sharing capabilities, serving as an excellent example of cross-platform video application development.

repos.description: On-device subtitle generation that connects directly to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects.
repos.summary_zh: AutoSubs 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的跨平台 AI 字幕生成工具，本地运行 Whisper 等模型实现高精度语音转录。支持说话人分离、多语言翻译，可导出 SRT 或直接导入 DaVinci Resolve 进行高级样式定制。无需云端订阅，保障数据隐私，为视频创作者提供高效、可定制的自动化字幕解决方案。
repos.summary_en: AutoSubs is a cross-platform desktop application that generates AI-powered subtitles locally on user devices without cloud dependencies. Built on Tauri framework with React frontend and Rust backend, it leverages state-of-the-art models including Whisper, Parakeet and Pyannote for accurate transcription, speaker diarization and translation. The tool offers one-click export to SRT or direct integration with DaVinci Resolve, featuring per-speaker styling and real-time editing capabilities. Designed for video creators and post-production professionals, it delivers privacy-preserving, efficient subtitle workflows with full customization options.

repos.description: skill to create best prompts for generating videos with seedance2.0
repos.summary_zh: 该GitHub仓库提供针对字节跳动Seedance 2.0多模态AI视频生成模型的提示词撰写技能，专为Claude等AI智能体设计。核心包括输入约束、@引用语法、镜头语言、提示结构模式及多场景模板，覆盖广告、戏剧、MV和教育内容。基于官方文档，助力用户通过结构化提示工程高效生成高质量视频提示，提升AI视频创作的专业水平与效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides specialized skills for AI agents to craft optimal prompts for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 multimodal video generation model. It covers input constraints, @ reference syntax, camera language, prompt structures, and ready-to-use templates for ads, dramas, MVs, and educational content. Based on official docs, it enables efficient high-quality prompt engineering in tools like Claude Code and Cursor, boosting video output across creative and commercial scenarios.

repos.description: List of Science courses with video lectures
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库聚合了MIT、斯坦福、耶鲁等顶尖学府的数学与科学视频课程资源，涵盖物理、量子力学、弦理论等前沿领域。核心价值在于提供免费、高质量的系统化学习材料，适合自学深造和教学参考。技术亮点是资源整合与分类，便于用户快速定位所需课程。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates a comprehensive collection of free video lectures from prestigious institutions including MIT, Stanford, and Yale, spanning mathematics, physics, quantum mechanics, string theory, and cosmology. It offers systematically organized, high-quality educational resources for self-paced learning and academic reference. The key technical value lies in its meticulous categorization and direct access to otherwise hard-to-find advanced course materials from world-renowned professors.

repos.description: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI视频转写工具，支持YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili等30+平台及本地音视频文件。采用字幕优先架构，无字幕时调用Faster-Whisper实现高精度语音识别，经AI优化后生成多语言摘要。支持任意OpenAI兼容API，Docker部署，适合内容创作者与研究者快速提取视频核心内容。
repos.summary_en: An open-source AI-powered video and podcast transcription tool supporting 30+ platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Bilibili, plus local audio/video file uploads. Its subtitle-first architecture extracts native subtitles instantly when available, using Faster-Whisper as fallback for high-accuracy speech recognition. The tool leverages any OpenAI-compatible API for intelligent text optimization, typo correction, and multi-language summarization. Built with FFmpeg for media processing and Docker support, it's ideal for content creators, researchers, and educators to efficiently convert multimedia content into structured, searchable text with AI-enhanced summaries.

repos.description: Seedance 2.0 prompt skill，使用该Skill生成Seedance 2.0 视频提示词
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为Claude Code定制的提示词技能，专为字节跳动Seedance 2.0视频生成平台设计。它能将自然语言创意转化为结构化生产级提示词，支持十大核心能力包括一致性控制、镜头动作复制、声音设计和音乐卡点。内置多模态参考系统、时间轴分镜技术和场景化策略，涵盖电商广告、短剧、仙侠动画等垂直领域，显著提升AI视频创作效率。
repos.summary_en: A custom Claude Code skill designed for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 video generation platform. It transforms natural language ideas into structured, production-ready prompts with ten core capabilities including consistency control, camera motion replication, sound design, and beat sync. Features multi-modal reference system, timestamp storyboarding, and scenario-specific strategies for e-commerce, short dramas, xianxia animation, and more, dramatically improving AI video creation efficiency.

repos.description: Render Anything Engine: tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games as React and TypeScript, rendered on your own GPU. Rust + Bevy, macOS, Linux and Windows.
repos.summary_zh: raea 是面向 AI 的渲染引擎，用自然语言描述需求，以 React/TypeScript 编写，在本地 GPU 渲染视频、动态图形、3D 和游戏。基于 Rust+Bevy，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。
repos.summary_en: raea is an AI-oriented rendering engine that lets you describe what to make in natural language, written as React and TypeScript, and rendered on your local GPU for videos, motion graphics, 3D, and games. Built with Rust and Bevy, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provides a desktop app and CLI tools, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, and can render frames, play live as a game, export standalone programs, and check quality issues such as clipped text or low contrast. Designed for AI-driven content creation, it enables anyone to generate professional-grade visuals quickly.

repos.description: A high-performance ASCII video rendering engine featuring real-time WebSocket binary streaming and an isolated compiler for serverless static generation. Built for low-latency 30 FPS playback on HTML5 Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: ASCILINE是一款高性能跨平台实时ASCII视频渲染引擎，通过WebSocket二进制帧流传输至HTML5 Canvas，实现超低延迟30FPS播放。核心价值在于将视频像素映射为纯文本画布，支持实时CSS滤镜、低带宽零GPU运行及轻量LLM的AI语义处理。采用Python/FastAPI后端结合OpenCV和NumPy解码映射，支持多色彩模式、自适应编解码、音频同步、播放列表及YouTube/摄像头流。适用于低资源设备、交互式网页媒体交付和嵌入式场景，无需传统视频标签。
repos.summary_en: ASCILINE is a high-performance, cross-platform real-time ASCII video rendering engine that streams binary-encoded frames via WebSockets to HTML5 Canvas for ultra-low latency 30 FPS playback. It transforms video into pure typographic canvas content, enabling real-time CSS filters, low-bandwidth zero-GPU operation on constrained devices, and seamless integration with lightweight LLMs for AI processing. Python/FastAPI backend uses OpenCV and NumPy for decoding and mapping; vanilla JS frontend handles rendering. Supports multiple color modes, adaptive codecs, audio sync, playlists, YouTube, and webcam streaming. Ideal for interactive web media, embedded systems, and low-resource environments without video elements.

repos.description: A new open-source format for interactive video on the web, with a built-in state machine, frame-accurate transitions, and packed-alpha transparency.
repos.summary_zh: AVAL 是一种开源网页交互式动画格式与运行时，支持内置确定性状态机、帧精确过渡、打包 alpha 透明度及连续部分循环。它将独立解码的运动单元和小型状态图编码在单个 .avl 资产中，浏览器维持解码时间线连续推进，无需视频 seek，实现 hover、focus 等状态驱动交互。提供编译器（FFmpeg）、Web 播放器元素及 graph/format/player 等包，支持 fallback 标记和 SSR。当前为技术预览，适用于短时预渲染动画的复杂状态管理与高效渲染。
repos.summary_en: AVAL is an open-source web format and runtime for short prerendered interactive animations. It features a built-in deterministic state machine, frame-accurate transitions, packed-alpha transparency, and continuous partial loops. The .avl asset encodes independently decodable motion units and a state graph, enabling the browser to maintain a continuous decoder timeline without seeking. Includes compiler using FFmpeg, web player element with fallback support, and packages for graph, format, and rendering. Ideal for state-driven web UIs with hover/focus interactions. Currently a technical preview leveraging WebCodecs.

repos.description: 👏 Make learning a lifelong habit. 学无止境
repos.summary_zh: my-geektime 是极客时间VIP课程的音视频私有化部署系统。支持一次缓存永久观看，一键发布课程为在线文档，以及本地音视频下载。基于Docker容器化技术，提供跨平台部署能力，实现学习资源的离线管理与在线访问，适合构建个人终身学习知识库。
repos.summary_en: my-geektime is a self-hosted GeekTime VIP course platform specializing in audio/video resource management. It enables permanent offline viewing through one-time caching, one-click online documentation publishing, and local media downloads. Built with Docker containerization for cross-platform deployment (amd64/arm64), it transforms streaming content into private learning assets. This tool eliminates dependency on official servers, providing lifelong access to purchased courses while maintaining content organization, search capabilities, and seamless playback functionality for individual learners.

repos.description: Code for the Molmo2 Vision-Language Model
repos.summary_zh: Molmo2 是艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）开源的视觉-语言模型，在视频理解、点驱动定位与跟踪任务上达到开源 SOTA 水平。支持单图、多图和视频推理，具备长上下文处理能力，提供 Transformers 和 vLLM 高效部署方案，适用于智能分析、视觉交互和自动化决策等场景。
repos.summary_en: Molmo2 is an open vision-language model from the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that achieves state-of-the-art performance in video understanding, point-driven grounding, and tracking among open-source models. It supports single-image, multi-image, and video inference with long-context capabilities. The repository provides comprehensive training/evaluation code, pre-trained checkpoints, and efficient deployment via Transformers and vLLM. Ideal for intelligent visual analysis, interactive grounding, and automated decision-making applications.

repos.description: Reusable AI video production skills library for creation, recreation, motion design, openers, and QA.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个长期维护的AI视频制作技能库，沉淀视频创作、复刻、动效设计、片头包装与质检等可复用方法。核心收录证据驱动的参考视频复刻质检（PSNR/SSIM验证）、暗色SaaS魔术短片生成及黑底白字打字开场技能，适用于Codex、Claude Code等AI代理。通过npx skills模块化安装与扩展，按视频类型和环节组织，显著提升专业视频生产效率与像素级质量控制。
repos.summary_en: This is a long-term maintained library of reusable AI video production skills, curating methods for video creation, recreation, motion design, opener packaging, and QA. It includes evidence-driven reference video replica QC with PSNR/SSIM verification, dark SaaS magic UI shorts, and black-white text typing openers. Designed for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code, it supports modular npx skills installation and structured extension by video type and workflow, boosting efficiency and precision in AI-assisted video production.

repos.description: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam
repos.summary_zh: VCamdroid 将 Android 手机摄像头转化为 Windows 高性能虚拟摄像头。通过 Softcam 的 DirectShow 滤镜实现与 Zoom、OBS、Teams 等应用的无缝兼容，支持 ADB 有线和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，采用 RTSP 协议、Camera2 API、OpenGL 预处理及硬件编码（H.264/HEVC），提供低延迟视频流。支持多设备切换、相机控制（前后摄、分辨率、闪光灯）及实时图像调整（旋转、翻转、亮度等），适用于视频会议、直播和录制场景。
repos.summary_en: VCamdroid turns your Android phone's camera into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows. It uses a custom DirectShow filter from the Softcam library for seamless compatibility with Zoom, OBS, Discord, and Teams. Supporting both ADB wired and Wi-Fi wireless connections via RTSP, it delivers low-latency, hardware-accelerated streams using Camera2 API, OpenGL preprocessing, and MediaCodec encoding. Features include multi-device support, full camera controls, and real-time image adjustments, ideal for video calls, streaming, and recording.

repos.description: 把一篇文章或一条视频（抖音、B 站、YouTube，先转逐字稿）一键做成小红书图文、杂志长图、公众号排版和 AI 配音口播短视频的开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill。21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖。
repos.summary_zh: 开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill，将文章或视频一键转化为小红书图文、公众号排版、杂志长图及 AI 配音口播短视频。10 个独立能力自由组合，21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖，仅需 Node.js 22 与 Chrome。
repos.summary_en: Open-source Claude Code / Codex Skill that transforms articles or videos into Xiaohongshu cards, WeChat layouts, magazine long images, and AI-narrated short videos. 10 independent capabilities, 21 themes, automated validation, zero npm dependencies, requiring only Node.js 22 and Chrome.

repos.description: Phantom-Motion is an incredibly powerful, epic interactive dynamic visual storytelling generator. Its capabilities are limited only by the bounds of your imagination! 它是一个极其硬核的史诗级交互式动态视觉叙事生成器。它的实力只取决于你的想象力高低！
repos.summary_zh: Phantom Motion 是一款基于 AI 的智能动态视觉叙事引擎，通过融合 GSAP 电影级运镜、Three.js GPGPU 粒子系统与 KaTeX 数学渲染，实现文本剧本到 60FPS 4K 商业视频的无缝转换。其 Audio-First 架构确保微秒级音画同步，Monocle 版式引擎与 WYSIWYG 交互套件支持所见即所得编辑，彻底革新传统影视制作流程。
repos.summary_en: Phantom Motion is an AI-powered dynamic visual storytelling engine that transforms text scripts into 60FPS 4K commercial videos. It integrates Hollywood-grade GSAP camera work, Three.js GPGPU particle systems, and KaTeX math rendering with Audio-First architecture for microsecond audio-visual sync. The Monocle layout engine and WYSIWYG editing suite revolutionize traditional video production workflows.

repos.description: Video to ASCII React component.
repos.summary_zh: react-video-ascii 是一个基于 WebGL2 的高性能 React 组件，可将视频实时转换为 ASCII 艺术。支持自定义字符集、亮度/饱和度调节及字形/亮度双渲染模式。内置鼠标悬停高亮/散射、点击波纹/扩散动画及加载揭示效果。适用于创意编码、艺术展示和网页特效场景，通过 GPU 加速确保流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: react-video-ascii is a high-performance React component that converts videos to ASCII art in real-time using WebGL2 acceleration. It offers extensive customization including character sets, brightness/saturation controls, and dual rendering modes (shape/luminance). Features interactive mouse hover effects (brighten/scatter), click animations (ripple/spread), and reveal transitions. Ideal for creative coding, artistic displays, and web experiments with smooth GPU-accelerated rendering.
